sub_objectives: Choose the response that most logically continues or completes each conversation.
objectives.title: Listening comprehension through short oral exchanges

sub_objectives: You’ll hear a series of selections, such as dialogues, announcements, and narratives. Each audio selection is accompanied by a graphic or picture and is followed by one or more questions.
objectives.title: Listening comprehension through longer spoken selections

sub_objectives: Each incomplete statement is followed by four suggested completions. Select the one that is best in each case.
objectives.title: Discrete sentences (vocabulary and structure)

sub_objectives: In each paragraph, there are blanks indicating that words or phrases have been omitted. First, read through the entire paragraph. Then, for each blank, choose the best completion, given the context for the entire paragraph.
objectives.title: Short cloze passages (vocabulary and structure)

sub_objectives: Each selection is followed by one or more questions, incomplete statements, or commands. For each question or incomplete statement, select the best answer or completion. For each command, click the appropriate area of the screen according to the directions given.
objectives.title: Reading passages and authentic stimulus materials (reading comprehension)
